scope: Known release dependency findings; final artifact scans and exact native inventories remain pending

pcre2.facts: Qt builds 16-bit PCRE2, omits pcre2_convert.c and disables JIT for the Apple arm64 slice. Windows x64 and macOS x86_64 still require JIT/call-path review. Stripped public symbol absence does not establish code absence. Exact Qt source compiles all three JIT modes, assigns a growable 32 KiB to 512 KiB stack after the default stack limit, and creates fresh match data per invocation.

decisions.basis: Upstream describes 32-bit size_t automatic allocation in pattern conversion. Qt excludes that translation unit and both delivered architectures use 64-bit size_t.
Upstream requires the 32-bit-code-unit compile API on a 32-bit process. Qt selects 16-bit PCRE2 in 64-bit artifacts.

Affected JIT-mode mismatch requires invalid UTF and a match mode absent from compilation. Qt optimizePattern requests COMPLETE, PARTIAL_SOFT and PARTIAL_HARD together, the documented workaround. Upstream does not establish 16-bit immunity by itself.
decisions.proposed: workaround present in source; independent binary/call-path decision pending

decisions.basis: Upstream requires PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF with backwards lookbehind. Qt's complete PatternOptions/MatchOptions conversion does not set that flag; a disabled translation-string occurrence is not an executable option.

Qt calls pcre2_match_16 with newly created per-invocation match data, not direct pcre2_jit_match or COPY_MATCHED_SUBJECT reuse. The upstream fix concerns copied-subject ownership in the direct JIT API.
Serialize encoding is compiled into the source library but is not called by Qt's QRegularExpression implementation. Do not equate lack of a public symbol with lack of compiled code.
decisions.proposed: unused affected API in traced consumer; independent decision pending

decisions.basis: All code-unit widths through 10.48 are affected with JIT, a growable stack and attacker-controlled regex. First-party QRegularExpression constructors use committed fixed patterns; KSyntaxHighlighting 6.28.1 loads packaged definitions only, and DynamicRegExpr substitutes source captures through QRegularExpression::escape in rule.cpp replaceCaptures(..., true). This supports a trusted-pattern applicability proposal; exact native dependency identities and independent acceptance remain required.
decisions.proposed: source-backed trusted-pattern non-applicability proposal; independent decision pending

pcre2.available_remediation: PCRE2 10.49 fixes the September 28 growable-JIT-stack flaw as well as earlier flaws. Version 10.48 is incomplete remediation. The official Qt 6.11 archive currently offers 6.11.2 only. A rebuilt qualified Qt producer with pinned 10.49 or backports is the alternative to independent applicability acceptance.
pcre2.coverage_gap: Upstream GHSA-3r4p-g7gg-ppmf / CVE-2026-86145 DFA-recursion heap-limit advisory is not in these raw reports. Qt compiles DFA code but its traced QRegularExpression path uses pcre2_match_16. Feed silence does not close coverage.

windows_zlib.basis: The latest published zlib 1.3.2 lacks the September 17 gz_vacate pointer-reset fix. Qt includes gzwrite.c in its static source target. The advisory's path follows failed nonblocking gzwrite with gzprintf/gzvprintf; Qt's non-third-party C++ consumers contain no calls to these APIs.
windows_zlib.binary_evidence: Native dumpbin on every extracted DLL found no z_gzwrite/z_gzprintf/z_gzvprintf/z_gzclose import or export. Qt6Core.dll SHA256 22c113a5644b875b2c85482723cd5d2e6a3a4029169778fcc78adde08ef3b6aa has a Valid The QT Company Oy signature and exports ordinary z_crc32/z_inflate APIs. This supports a reachability review, not proof of stripped internal-code absence.
windows_zlib.proposed: Retain High blocker pending independent source/call-path adjudication or a newly qualified fixed producer. No released zlib replacement containing the fix was found.

sqlite.basis: SQLite upstream lists fixes in 3.43.2, 3.49.1 and 3.50.2 respectively; exact pinned 3.53.4 is newer. Raw Bitnami matches use unbounded/unknown version constraints despite these fixed versions.
sqlite.proposed: Version-range false matches supported by upstream and pinned source identity; independent named security-owner acceptance remains required for the High match. Keep all raw matches.

tika.basis: Qt includes the attributed tika-mimetypes.xml data resource, not Java Tika parsers/server/JARs. Its PURL even identifies that XML subpath. The wildcard Tika CPE is matched against old Java application version ranges using a git commit as version. Apache advisories describe those executable handlers, not this MIME table; exact package inventories contain no Java runtime or Tika server.
tika.proposed: Component-identity mismatch; independent Critical/High applicability approval pending. Retain original upstream attribution, license, PURL and CPE rather than editing metadata to quiet the scanner.

macos_system_zlib.basis: Both QtCore Mach-O slices link Apple's /usr/lib/libz.1.dylib, recording 1.2.12. The macOS26.6.2 host's zlibVersion also reports 1.2.12; do not claim it is 1.3.2. Apple lists CVE-2022-37434 as addressed in Ventura13, the declared minimum. SDK/ABI version is not an OS patch inventory.
macos_system_zlib.proposed: CVE-2022-37434 has vendor-fixed minimum-OS evidence; independent exact-OS acceptance remains pending. CVE-2026-27171 is reproduced on the current host and requires separate unused-API applicability acceptance. No blanket macOS waiver.

crc_combine_analysis.native_observation: macOS 26.6.2 arm64 /usr/lib/libz.1.dylib reports 1.2.12. Positive crc32_combine input matches the independently calculated CRC; crc32_combine and crc32_combine_gen with length -1 each exceed a one-second child timeout. Each owned child was terminated and reaped. The 64-suffixed APIs are not exported on this host. This is actual vulnerable API behavior, not vendor-patch evidence.
crc_combine_analysis.call_path_analysis: A streamed scan of all 8,572 C/C++ source/header files in the exact retained QtBase-6.11.2.tar.xz corresponding-source archive found zero non-third-party calls to crc32_combine*, gzwrite, gzprintf or gzvprintf. Third-party matches remain in bundled zlib/Freetype declarations and implementation. First-party src and the pinned LibArchive sources contain no crc32_combine calls. This supports unused affected API review, not absence of vulnerable system-library bytes or qualification of every supported OS.
crc_combine_analysis.proposed_disposition: Affected system API exists; unused affected API in the traced application/Qt/LibArchive consumer. Independent exact-artifact applicability acceptance remains pending.

dbus.basis: The matched 1.13.12 item is libdbus header declarations/constants, not the vulnerable message-validation implementation or daemon. QtDBus can dynamically load external libdbus, so header-only attribution does not certify the OS library on every runtime.
dbus.proposed: Attribution versus external-runtime distinction documented; lower-severity and complete native-load scope still pending.
dbus.actual_ubuntu_runtime: libdbus-1-3:amd64 1.16.2-2ubuntu4, coordinator native dpkg observation on 2026-10-12; final runtime bindings remain required.

qt_current_patch_coverage.basis: Exact Qt commit ef55f427f2c8b410d34f8a7681020a3000cf6866 files were fetched with recorded hashes. qxmlstream.cpp already contains both CVE-2026-16762 patch changes: duplicate tracker and compact two-view AttributeName. This is already-fixed source evidence. qdomhelpers.cpp lacks CVE-2026-82292 null checks, but no first-party QDom/Qt6::Xml dependency is selected and the v0.1.9 Mac SPDX contains no QtXml runtime. Final native selected-module inventories and independent disposition remain required.
qt_current_patch_coverage.proposed: off-feed applicability coverage proposals; not blanket absence-of-vulnerabilities claim

ubuntu_zlib.basis: Canonical lists Ubuntu26.04 zlib as vulnerable with a deferred fix. Its notes warn that older-version applicability is uncertain. Do not infer safety from version text or the earlier e3dc0a8 patch.
ubuntu_zlib.native_inventory: Pending exact QtCore linkage, runtime zlib package/source/patch identity and final artifact binding.
ubuntu_zlib.proposed: Retain High blocker pending exact-source affected-API reachability adjudication by an independent security owner or a newly qualified fixed producer.

independent_acceptance.note: Critical/High findings block until fixed or independently accepted for the exact delivered versions/bytes. Source analysis is not self-approval.

proposed_recheck_conditions: Before any release with changed application source, Qt or other dependency bytes, selected modules, architecture, or minimum supported OS.
Before publication if the final corresponding-source asset, executable, SPDX or native runtime identities differ from those reviewed.
Immediately upon a new relevant advisory, available vendor fix, new affected call path, or changed trust boundary; refresh the vulnerability database within 72 hours of each release scan.
required_bindings: Qt/dependency identities and native runtime/OS inventory
Named independent security owner and individual disposition per advisory
proposed_review_terms.note: A proposed expiry is not acceptance. Critical/High findings remain blockers until the required independent owner approves exact applicability evidence or a qualified remediation replaces the affected bytes.
